description: The current test rows, one per test, a standard table search: {items, more}, each item keyed by its full key, script|suite|test|flipped, its label the row. script and suite each optional: left out, any. The words narrow among them, '' for all. Most severe first, the newest flip first among equals. Given a test with its script and its suite, every row of that one test instead, current or not, the newest flip first: its history (a test without its script and suite is refused).
